item.title: RNRM800: Eight Hundred!? | Rock N Roll Manifesto
item.description: That's right, 800 episodes of the Rock N Roll Manifesto are now in the books. I played some old standbys tonight that have been a big part of the Manifesto for a long time, plus I had some new stuff from Special Forces 805, Iris Paralysis, Disposable Dogs, and Inflatable Idols, and a whole lot more. Listen and celebrate 800 episodes with me!
